issuing_body: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications / Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry

evidence.quote: it is important to understand in advance the magnitude of risks that can arise from the mode of use in a given field and to align the degree of countermeasures with the magnitude of risk under a risk-based approach
help people who use AI in various business activities correctly recognize AI risks in light of international trends and stakeholder concerns
safe and secure use of AI will be promoted
a goal-based approach that seeks to achieve policy objectives through non-binding soft law while encouraging voluntary efforts by stakeholders
new set of Guidelines for business operators to implement AI social deployment and governance together as non-binding soft law

implementation_notes: Document is explicitly non-binding soft law using a goal-based approach. It integrates three previous guidelines (AI R&D Guidelines, AI Utilization Guidelines, Governance Guidelines Ver.1.1). Intended as a living document to be updated via agile governance. Full policy details are in Parts 2-5 which are not fully represented in the extracted text.
